hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; F=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); F="${F//\\//}"; case "$F" in *.php) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$F" in */vendor/*) exit 0;; esac; out=$(./vendor/bin/pint --test "$F" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; F=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); F="${F//\\//}"; case "$F" in */app/*|*/database/*|*/routes/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; out=$(./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse "$F" --no-progress --memory-limit=2G 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
